channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: Eric Knowles heads to Ardingly Antiques Fair in West Sussex for this episode of Bargain Hunt. Experts Kate Bliss and Gary Pe are on hand to help the red and blue teams pick the best bargains to take to auction. While the teams are busy shopping, Eric asks fairgoers to guess what a mystery item was used for.
